observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment pytest, Python compileall, and Git diff checks

verified_behaviors: Routed semantic subjects are associated only with owners whose input mask admits the event.
Trace projection retains bounded sanitized non-path subject identities and explicit omission counts.
Owner summary schema 4 carries bounded trigger evidence with exact service execution identity and remains able to read schema 1 through 3.
A known trigger kind remains visible with an explicit zero-subject count.
Store replay diagnostics survive a route failure followed by an unknown post-pass Store observation.
outcome.scope_limit: The repository-wide suite was not run; 21 tests requiring the unselected external compiler and Automation checkout were skipped.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Ambient owner traces lose trigger context and Store replay reporting can crash
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment coherence routing and ECI compaction
pressure_hypothesis.basis: The baseline selected-session ECI summary used schema 3 and had no semantic-subject fields. A later resident attempt ended with KeyError while updating Store replay diagnostics after a route or observation failure.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Preserve bounded sanitized routed subjects and trigger kinds with exact service execution identity; initialize replay diagnostics before fallible routing; measure stage resource cost without attributing the observed I/O to a specific subsystem.

measurement_limits: The skipped tests require the external compiler and Automation checkout; this session did not select that repository.
The route-error regression injects an early routing failure and unknown post-pass Store observation; it does not reproduce the process I/O or identify its source.
Tests establish trace integrity and diagnostic survival, not service correctness, agent receipt, ambient fulfillment, or burden reduction.
